conceptual_statement: Massachusetts research stays in six specialist products: DPU mover certificates, DOB mortgage license files, contractor discipline and debarment, DOI company and designation files, DPH and AGE care classes beside CMS, and separate Massachusetts adviser registration lenses. Ask routes to those pages. It does not copy their records or add them into one Massachusetts total.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /massachusetts pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /massachusetts is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate.

intelligence_strip.grain: Intrastate DPU household-goods certificate identity, not USDOT and not MC. 309 regulated-mover rows. Exact USDOT joins: 0. Exact MC joins: 0. Listing is not an invented Active status.
Company licenses on the mortgage-lender file only. Broker company NMLS IDs, MLO persons, and branch NMLS IDs are separate grains. HMDA is federal activity, not licensing.
Discipline evidence from 364 complaints, not a contractor census. HIC and CSL lookups are known. Both bulk rosters were not acquired.

intelligence_strip.display: 1,693 distinct NAIC identities on the DOI licensed/approved company source
intelligence_strip.grain: Legal-company identity. Designation lists, 1,000 non-NAIC research rows, and enforcement indexes are separate. Agency and producer bulk rosters were not acquired.
One DPH facility class. Rest Homes, assisted living residences, home health, hospice, and CMS counts are separate. Proven exact state-to-CMS bridges: 0, which is not zero real-world overlap.
State registration only. ERA filings, federal notice filings, and the principal-office roster are separate lenses. 794 state IA rows also include CONDREST and TERMREQUEST.

what_makes_massachusetts_different: Move: the public identity is a DPU intrastate mover certificate and a filed tariff, not a USDOT or MC number.
Lender: the Division of Banks publishes downloadable company and MLO licensing files. Broker, branch, and person rows stay separate.
Contractor: HIC, CSL, and the professional trades are separate regulatory systems. The acquired statewide evidence is discipline and debarment, not a license census.
Insurance: the Division of Insurance publishes a legal-company universe plus separate designation files.
Senior: DPH facility classes and AGE assisted living residences sit beside CMS. They are not one senior-facility total.
Investor: state IA, ERA, notice, and principal-office lenses are separately available through accepted IAPD feeds.

CROSS_HUB_RECORD_TOTAL.explanation: Massachusetts evidence uses incompatible grains: mover certificate identities, tariff rows, mortgage company licenses, branches, MLO persons, contractor discipline events, debarment parties, insurance legal companies, insurance designations, enforcement events, nursing homes, rest homes, assisted living residences, home health agencies, hospice programs, investment adviser firms, ERA filings, notice filings, and enforcement documents. Those grains cannot be summed into Massachusetts businesses, providers, licensed professionals, or Trust Hub records.
